messages.text: Story contains made-up phone number. Do we quarantine?
The phone number looks deliberately fictional in this story and is not linked to any identifiable person. We need to verify that no real individual can be identified from the details.
Is there any non-fictional contact information elsewhere in the example? The difference between invented contact text and genuine personal information is central.
